title: Dashboard enhancements
body:
* **Larger subscription email attachments**: Dashboard subscription emails now support up to 24 MB of combined attachments, up from 9 MB. See [Dashboard subscription limits](/aws/en/dashboards/limits#subscription-limits).
* **Recreate dashboards from screenshots**: Genie Code for dashboard authoring now reproduces the visual styling of a screenshot more closely when you recreate a dashboard from it.
